Glance 2026.09.30.1 updates the settings interface.

- Unify built-in and component settings with shared page, section and control rendering.
- Improve page transitions, scrolling, card spacing and localized settings updates.
- Bring an existing settings window to the foreground when opened from the tray.
- Show reset confirmation on the reset button for two seconds.
- Update the default footer fields and order: size, line endings, media information, capture time, capture parameters and modification time.
